titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Solomon's Lament for Zion (ch. 60, part 1)
part: ch. 60, part 1 — Solomon's Lament for Zion
about: Solomon, realizing that the Ark of the Covenant (Zion) has gone from Israel, goes into his tent and weeps. He reminds God of the covenants with Noah, Abraham, Isaac, Israel, Moses and Aaron, recalls David's wish and his own building of the Temple, and then pours out a litany of loss, with the refrain አሌለነ 'woe to us', confessing that Israel's sin brought this. Eight short sentences affirm that God alone governs. The part ends mid-chapter, with the lament still going.

sentences.t: ፷ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ላሐዋ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ለጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 60. toward(?) lament Solomon for-Zion
sentences.i: Solomon's lament for Zion (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ ላሐዋ is the hard part: ላሐወ is 'to lament, wail' and ኀበ 'to, where, at', but how the two combine (a relative 'where/how Solomon lamented', or ላሐዋ as a noun 'lament') I cannot settle without Dillmann, so the English is a hedge (?). ለጽዮን 'for/over Zion' (ለ- 'to, for'; ጽዮን Zion is feminine and stands for the Ark). ሰሎሞን Solomon. The number ፷ is 60. Chapter 60 is the turning point: Solomon realizes the Ark has gone.

sentences.t: ወቦአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኀይመቱ ፡ ወበከየ ፡ ብካየ ፡ መሪረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ በመዋዕልየኑ ፡ ትነሥኣ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ኪዳንከ ፡ እምኔነ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-entered into his-tent and-he-wept weeping bitter, while he-says: 'Lord, in-my-days-indeed(?) you-take-her the-ark-of covenant-your from-us;
sentences.i: He went into his tent and wept with bitter weeping, saying, 'Lord, are you to take the Ark of your covenant from us in my days?
sentences.n: ወ- 'and' opens most units: ወቦአ 'and he entered', ወበከየ 'and he wept' (ብካየ መሪረ 'bitter weeping', an accusative of the same root). እንዘ ይብል 'while saying' (እንዘ + imperfect gives a circumstantial clause). ታቦተ ኪዳንከ is a construct chain: ታቦት 'ark' in the construct state ታቦተ, then ኪዳን 'covenant' + ከ 'your'. -ኑ on በመዋዕልየኑ is the question particle (my reading), hence the question. ትነሥኣ 'you take her' (2nd person imperfect + ኣ 'her'); the Ark is treated as feminine. ኀይመቱ 'his tent/chamber' (?).

sentences.t: ባሕቱ ፡ እምቀደምከ ፡ ነሢአ ፡ ነፍስየ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ ዘበመዋዕልየ ፡ ትነሥኣ ፤
sentences.l: But before-you(?) taking soul-my from-her, that-in-my-days you-take-her;
sentences.i: But before you take my soul from her, (let it not be) that you take her in my days (?);
sentences.n: A compressed, elliptical clause, and I am not sure of the construction (?). እምቀደምከ 'before you [do this]' (እም- 'from, than' + ቀደመ 'precede' + ከ 'you'); ነሢአ is an infinitive 'taking'; ነፍስየ 'my soul/life'; እምኔሃ 'from her' (the Ark). The supplied '(let it not be)' is my reading of the sense: take my life first, not the Ark in my days. ዘበመዋዕልየ: ዘ- 'that/which' + በ- 'in' + መዋዕል 'days'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አንተሰ ፡ ኢትሔሱ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወኢትዔምፅ ፡ ኪዳነከ ፡ ዘተካየድከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አበዊነ ፤
sentences.l: For you-indeed not-you-lie word-your and-not-you-break covenant-your which-you-covenanted with fathers-our;
sentences.i: For you do not go back on your word, and you do not break your covenant, which you made with our fathers:
sentences.n: እስመ 'for, because'; -ሰ on አንተሰ is an emphatic 'as for you'. ኢትሔሱ 'you do not lie' (ሐሰወ 'to lie', negated by ኢ-); ኢትዔምፅ 'you do not wrong/break' (ዐመፀ). ዘተካየድከ 'which you covenanted' (ዘ- relative + ተካየደ 'to make a covenant', a reciprocal stem). ምስለ 'with'; አበዊነ 'our fathers' (irregular plural of አብ).

sentences.t: ምስለ ፡ ኖኅ ፡ ገብርከ ፡ ዘዐቀባ ፡ ለጽድቅ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ዘኢተዐደወ ፡ ትእዛዝከ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ቊልዔከ ፡ ዘአንጽሐ ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ እምርስሐተ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ወምስለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ቅዱስከ ፡ ዘአስተባዛኅከ ፡ በመንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወሰመይኮ ፡ አሠረ ፡ ዚአከ ፤ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: With Noah servant-your who-kept righteousness, and-with Abraham who-not-transgressed commandment-your, and-with Isaac child-your who-purified body-his from-defilement-of sin, and-with Israel holy-one-your whom-you-multiplied by-spirit holy, and-you-named-him track(?) yours: Israel;
sentences.i: With Noah your servant, who kept righteousness; with Abraham, who did not transgress your commandment; with Isaac your child, who cleansed his body of the defilement of sin; and with Israel your holy one, whom you multiplied by the Holy Spirit and named — after your own track (?) — Israel;
sentences.n: A list of the covenant partners, each introduced by ምስለ 'with' (ወምስለ 'and with'). Noah (Genesis 9), Abraham (Genesis 17), Isaac, Israel (Jacob renamed, Genesis 32:28). ዘ- 'who' begins each relative clause: ዘዐቀባ 'who guarded it', ዘኢተዐደወ 'who did not cross over' (ተዐደወ), ዘአንጽሐ 'who made clean', ዘአስተባዛኅከ 'whom you made numerous'. ርስሐተ ኀጢአት 'defilement-of sin' is a construct chain. Two doubtful points: ሰመይኮ is 'you named him' (-ከ + ሁ contracts to -ኮ); but አሠረ ዚአከ 'your track/footprint (አሠር)' is obscure (?). Bezold's text has a stray repeated እስራኤል ፤ right after the ፤; I joined it to this unit rather than leave a one-word unit (source oddity kept in t).

sentences.t: ወምስለ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ካህናቲከ ፡ እለ ፡ በመዋዕሊሆሙ ፡ አውረድካ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ርስትከ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ሕግከ ፡ ወትእዛዝከ ፡ በአርአያ ፡ ሥርዐተ ፡ መላእክት ፤
sentences.l: And-with Moses and-Aaron priests-your, who in-their-days you-brought-down the-ark-of law from-heaven onto earth, for-sons-of Jacob inheritance-your, with law-your and-commandment-your, in-likeness-of order-of angels;
sentences.i: And with Moses and Aaron, your priests, in whose days you brought the Ark of the Law down from heaven to earth for the children of Jacob, your inheritance, together with your law and your commandment, after the likeness of the order of the angels;
sentences.n: ወምስለ continues the list. ካህናቲከ 'your priests' (plural of ካህን + ከ). እለ is the plural relative 'who/those who' (cf. ዘ- singular); በመዋዕሊሆሙ 'in their days'. አውረድካ 'you brought down her' (አውረደ causative of ወረደ 'descend'). The Kebra Nagast's doctrine is that the Ark is heavenly and was lowered to earth. ደቂቀ ያዕቆብ 'sons-of Jacob' (construct chain; ደቂቅ is the plural of ወልድ). በአርአያ ሥርዐተ መላእክት: ሥርዐት 'order, ordinance'; the earthly law copies the heavenly order (compare Exodus 25:40).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አቅደምከ ፡ ሳርሮታ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ለማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ መቅደስከ ፡ ወበዳግምሰ ፡ ወሀብኮለሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያሰኒ ፡ ገቢሮታ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወያንብራ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘስምዕ ፡ ከመ ፡ አንተኒ ፡ ትምጻእ ፡ ህየ ፡ እምደብረ ፡ መቅደስከ ፡ ወታስ ፡ ምዖሙ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ በትእዛዝከ ።
sentences.l: For you-did-first(?) founding-her(?) of-Zion for-dwelling-of glory-your in mountain-of sanctuary-your, and-the-second-time you-gave-him(?) to-Moses that he-take-care making-her on earth and-set-her in tent-of testimony, that you-also come there from mountain-of sanctuary-your and-make-them-hear word-your, that they-walk in commandment-your.
sentences.i: For you had first established (?) Zion as the dwelling of your glory on the mountain of your sanctuary; and a second time you gave charge to Moses to take care to make her on earth and to set her in the Tent of Testimony, so that you too would come there from the mountain of your sanctuary and make them hear your word, that they might walk in your commandment.
sentences.n: Heavenly Zion (the first, in heaven) and its earthly copy (the second, given to Moses) is the theological point; Exodus 25–26 (the tabernacle, 'tent of testimony', ደብተራ ዘስምዕ). አቅደምከ 'you did first' (አቅደመ causative of ቀደመ). ሳርሮታ is unclear to me — I take it as an infinitive 'founding/establishing her' with ታ 'her' (?). ለጽዮን / ለማኅደረ: ለ- marks the object / 'as, for'. ወበዳግምሰ 'and, the second time'. ወሀብኮለሙሴ is printed as one word: ወሀብኮ ለሙሴ 'you gave him/it to Moses' (-ኮ = -ከ + ሁ); the ከመ clause shows what was given: the charge. ከመ + subjunctive 'so that' (ያሰኒ, ያንብራ, ይሖሩ). Source oddity: ታስ ፡ ምዖሙ is one word ታስምዖሙ 'you make them hear' (አስምዐ) wrongly spaced; kept.

sentences.t: አእመርኩ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተሀየይከ ፡ ርስተከ ፡ እምነ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሕዝበከ ፤
sentences.l: I-knew now that you-turned-from(?) inheritance-your from Israel people-your;
sentences.i: I know now that you have turned away from (?) your inheritance, from Israel your people;
sentences.n: አእመርኩ 'I knew/I have known' (perfect, 1st person); ይእዜ 'now'; ከመ 'that'. The verb ተሀየየ recurs in this speech (8, 17, 18, 19) and seems to mean 'turn away from, change away from', but I am not certain (?); the sense of the sentence — the Ark's departure — is clear. ርስተከ 'your inheritance' (the Ark/Zion is God's own inheritance). እምነ before Israel is 'from'.

sentences.t: ወእስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ወኢያሠነይነ ፡ ተግባራ ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ተምዐዕከነ ፡ ወሜጥከ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ እምኔነ ፤
sentences.l: And-until now she-was with-us, and-not-we-did-well her-service, and-therefore you-were-angry-with-us and-you-turned face-your from-us;
sentences.i: And until now she has been with us, but we did not do well by her service, and therefore you were angry with us and turned your face away from us;
sentences.n: ወእስከ ይእዜ 'and until now'. ሀለወት 'she is/was (present)'; ምስሌነ 'with us'. ኢያሠነይነ 'we did not make good' (አሠነየ). ተግባራ 'her work/service'. ወበእንተዝ 'and for this reason' (በእንተ 'on account of' + ዝ 'this'). ተምዐዕከነ 'you were angry with us'; ሜጥከ ገጸከ 'you turned your face' — the standard biblical idiom for God withdrawing favour.

sentences.t: እግዚኦ ፡ ኢትነጽር ፡ ምግባረነ ፡ እኩየ ፡ አላ ፡ ነጽር ፡ ኂሩቶሙ ፡ ለአበዊነ ፡ ቀደምት ።
sentences.l: Lord, not-look deed-our evil, but look goodness-their of-fathers-our former.
sentences.i: Lord, do not look at our evil deed; look instead at the goodness of our forefathers of old.
sentences.n: ኢትነጽር 'do not look' (ኢ- plus jussive: a negative command); ነጽር is the imperative 'look'. እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). ኂሩቶሙ ለአበዊነ 'their goodness, of our fathers' — Geʿez often anticipates the owner with a pronoun suffix (ኂሩቶሙ) and then names it with ለ-. ቀደምት 'former ones'. This is the plea of the ordinary penitential prayer.

sentences.t: አቡየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ገብርከ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ይሕንጽ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ለስምከ ፡ ሰሚዖ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ነቢይከ ፡ ዘይቤ ፡ አይኑ ፡ ቤት ፡ ለማኅደርየ ፡ ወአይኑ ፡ መካን ፡ ለምዕራፍየ ፡ አኮኑ ፡ እደዊየ ፡ ዘገብራ ፡ ዘኵሎ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘኵሎ ፡ ይመልክ ፤
sentences.l: Father-my David servant-your wished he-build house for-name-your, having-heard word-of prophet-your who-said: 'Which house for-dwelling-my and-which place for-rest-my? Not-indeed hands-my that-made all?' said the-Lord who-all rules;
sentences.i: David my father, your servant, wished to build a house for your name, having heard the word of your prophet, who said: 'What house is there for my dwelling, and what place for my rest? Was it not my hands that made all things?' said the Lord who rules over all;
sentences.n: David's wish to build the Temple (2 Samuel 7:1–7; the words echo Isaiah 66:1–2 'what house will you build for me, and what is the place of my rest? my hand made all these'). ነቢይከ 'your prophet' (Nathan in 2 Samuel). አይኑ = አይ 'which, what' + the particle -ኑ. ፈቀደ ይሕንጽ 'he wished (that) he build'. ሰሚዖ 'having heard' (converb). ዘይቤ 'who said'. ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules everything' (መለከ 'to reign'). Grammar of ዘገብራ ዘኵሎ is loose (?): I read 'that made it/all'.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ኀለየ ፡ ትቤሎ ፡ ኢይትከሀለከ ፡ ዘዘንተ ፡ ሐነጽከ ፡ አላ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምሐቌከ ፡ የሀንጽ ፡ ሊተ ።
sentences.l: And-this when he-thought, you-said to-him: 'Not-it-is-possible for-you that-this you-build, but he-who came-out from-your-loins will-build for-me.'
sentences.i: And when he thought of this, you said to him, 'It is not for you to build this; the one who comes out of your own loins will build for me.'
sentences.n: ሶበ 'when'. ትቤሎ 'you said to him' (perfect 2nd masc. of ይቤ with ለ + ሁ → -ሎ). ኢይትከሀለከ 'it is not possible/permitted for you' (impersonal passive of ክህለ 'be able'). ዘወፅአ እምሐቌከ 'who came out of your loins' — Solomon himself, the son, is meant (2 Samuel 7:12–13). የሀንጽ ሊተ 'he will build for me' (ሊተ 'to me', cf. አሌሊተ below).

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ኢተሐሰወ ፡ ቃልከ ፡ ወሐነጽኩ ፡ ቤተከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ አንተ ፡ ረዳእየ ፤
sentences.l: And-now Lord, not-was-proved-false word-your, and-I-built house-your while you my-helper;
sentences.i: And now, Lord, your word has not proved false: I built your house, with you as my helper;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (-ኒ adds emphasis). ኢተሐሰወ 'was not made false' (passive of ሐሰወ; compare ኢትሔሱ above). ሐነጽኩ 'I built' (1st sg perfect). Solomon is the speaker: the Temple. ረዳእየ 'my helper' (ረዳኢ + የ).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ፈጸምኩ ፡ ሐኒጾ ፡ ቤትከ ፡ አባእክዋ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ኪዳን ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ወሦዕኩ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ለሥላሴ ፡ ስምከ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ወሐወጽከ ፡ ውስቴታ ፤
sentences.l: And-when I-finished building house-your, I-brought-in-her the-ark-of covenant within-her, and-I-offered sacrifice to-Trinity name-your holy, and-you-visited(?) within-her;
sentences.i: And when I finished building your house, I brought the Ark of the Covenant into it and offered sacrifice to the Trinity, your holy name; and you came into it (?);
sentences.n: The dedication of the Temple (1 Kings 8). ፈጸምኩ ሐኒጾ 'I finished building' (verb + converb). አባእክዋ 'I brought her in' (አብአ causative of ቦአ 'enter'). ታቦተ ኪዳን 'ark-of covenant'. ሥላሴ 'Trinity' — a Christian term in Solomon's mouth (Ethiopian Christian reading of the Old Testament). ሦዕኩ መሥዋዕተ 'I sacrificed a sacrifice'. ወሐወጽከ ውስቴታ: ሐወጸ is 'to go about, visit', so 'you visited/came into it' (?). ወ-, ለ-, ዘ- as before.

sentences.t: ወመልአ ፡ ቤት ፡ ስብሐቲከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ምሉእ ፡ መለኮትከ ፡ ወተፈሣሕነ ፡ ሕዝብከ ፡ በነጽሮ ፡ ስብሐቲከ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
sentences.l: And-filled(?) house-of glory-your while all world full divinity-your, and-we-rejoiced, people-your, in-seeing glory-your within-her.
sentences.i: And the house of your glory was filled (?), while all the world was full of your divinity; and we, your people, rejoiced to see your glory in it.
sentences.n: Compare 1 Kings 8:10–11, the glory filling the house. The verb መልአ 'filled/was full' has no stated subject (?): 'the house was filled' is my reading; it could be 'it filled the house'. ቤተ ስብሐቲከ is a construct chain. ኵሉ ዓለም ምሉእ መለኮትከ 'all the world full of your divinity' (ምሉእ 'full'). ተፈሣሕነ ሕዝብከ 'we rejoiced, your people' (apposition). በነጽሮ 'in the seeing of' (infinitive with በ-).

sentences.t: ወእምአሜሃሰ ፡ ዮም ፡ ሣልሲት ፡ ዓመታ ፡ ወመሠጥካ ፡ ለብርሃንነ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታብርህ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ነሠትካ ፡ ለክብርነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታክብሮሙ ፡ ለኅሱራን ፡ አ ፡ ጥፋእከ ፡ ግርማነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ታግርሞ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡ ግሩመ ፡ ነሠትካ ፡ ለሕይወትነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሕንጾለዘ ፡ ርሕቀ ፡ ሕይወቱ ፡ እምኔከ ።
sentences.l: And-from-then-indeed, today third year-of-it, you-snatched light-our from-us that you-give-light to-those in darkness; you-took glory-our that you-glorify the-lacking; you-destroyed awesomeness-our that you-make-awesome him-who not-was awesome; you-took life-our that you-build him-whose life far from-you.
sentences.i: And from then on — today is the third year — you snatched our light from us, so that you might give light to those in darkness; you took our glory, so that you might glorify the lacking; you destroyed our awesomeness, so that you might make awesome the one who was not awesome; you took our life, so that you might build up the one whose life is far from you.
sentences.n: Solomon states a paradox: what Israel loses, others gain. The four parallel ከመ-clauses ('so that you might...') each follow a perfect verb with ለ- + 'our X': ብርሃንነ 'our light', ክብርነ 'our glory', ግርማነ 'our awesomeness', ሕይወትነ 'our life'. This is the first hint that the Ark's loss means gain for another people — Ethiopia, in the story. Source oddities kept in t: አ ፡ ጥፋእከ is one word አጥፋእከ ('you destroyed') split by a wordspace; ትሕንጾለዘ is ትሕንጾ ለዘ fused. The verb endings -ካ in መሠጥካ ነሠትካ are variant spellings of 2nd masc. -ከ. ኅሱራን 'the lacking/poor' (ኅሱር). ዘ ኢኮነ ግሩመ 'who was not awesome'.

sentences.t: አሌሊተ ፡ አሌሊተ ፡ እበኪ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ርእስየ ፡ ተንሥእ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወብኪ ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተሀየየነ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ እምደቂቅከ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-me, woe-to-me, I-will-weep for self-my; arise David father-my and-weep with-me for lady-our, for God turned-from-us and-took lady-our from sons-your;
sentences.i: Woe to me, woe to me! I will weep for myself. Arise, David my father, and weep with me for our Lady, for God has turned away from us and taken our Lady from your children;
sentences.n: The mourning cry begins. አሌሊተ is አሌ 'woe' + ሊተ 'to me' ('woe to me'); the refrain below, አሌለነ, is አሌ + ለነ 'woe to us' (written once as two words, አሌ ፡ ለነ). እበኪ 'let me weep' (1st sg subjunctive). ተንሥእ 'arise' (imperative) and ብኪ 'weep!' — Solomon calls on his dead father David. እግዝእትነ 'our Lady' (አግዚእት 'mistress'): the Ark/Zion, feminine. ተሀየየነ 'turned from us' (?) as above. ደቂቅከ 'your sons' (David's descendants).

sentences.t: አሌሊተ ፡ አሌሊተ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተሀየየኒ ፡ ፀሐየ ፡ ጽድቅ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-me, woe-to-me, for turned-from-me sun-of righteousness;
sentences.i: Woe to me, woe to me, for the sun of righteousness has turned away from me;
sentences.n: ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun-of righteousness' is a construct chain naming God (Malachi 4:2, 'sun of righteousness', read by Christians as Christ). ተሀየየኒ 'turned from me' (-ኒ 'me').

sentences.t: አሌሊተ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘተሀየይነ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ኅሱራነ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ካህናትኒ ፡ ኢያሠነይነ ፡ ወነገሥትኒ ፡ ኢያርታዕነ ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-me, because we-turned-from commandment-of God-our, we-became lacking on earth; priests-too not-they-did-well, and-kings-too not-they-made-straight judgment for-orphan;
sentences.i: Woe to me! Because we turned away from the commandment of our God, we became lacking on the earth: even the priests did not act well, and even the kings did not set judgment straight for the orphan;
sentences.n: በእንተ ዘ- 'because of the fact that'. ኮነ is here 1st plural 'we became' (ኮነ = ኮንነ; the same reading in 38). ኅሱራነ 'lacking ones' (accusative). -ኒ on ካህናትኒ and ነገሥትኒ is 'also/even'. ኢያርታዕነ ፍትሐ 'they did not make judgment straight' (አርትዐ 'make straight/right'; ኢ- negation). እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan' is literally 'offspring-of the dead' (a construct chain); the Bible demands justice for orphans, e.g. Psalm 82:3, Isaiah 1:17.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀለፈት ፡ ርትዕ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወተገሠጽነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, for passed righteousness from-us and-we-were-rebuked;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us, for righteousness has passed from us and we were rebuked;
sentences.n: Refrain: አሌለነ 'woe to us'. ኀለፈት 'she/it passed' (feminine verb with ርትዕ 'righteousness'); እምኔነ 'from us'. ተገሠጽነ 'we were rebuked/corrected' (passive of ገሠጸ).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ ፍሥሓነ ፡ ተመይጠት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጸላእትነ ፡ ወሞገስነ ፡ ተረስዐት ፡ እምላዕሌነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, joy-our turned to enemies-our, and-favour-our was-forgotten from-upon-us;
sentences.i: Woe to us! Our joy has turned to our enemies, and our favor has been forgotten from over us;
sentences.n: ተመይጠት 'turned' (ተመይጠ 'to turn, return') with ኀበ 'to'. ጸላእትነ 'our enemies' (plural of ጸላኢ). ሞገስ 'grace, favor'; ተረስዐት 'was forgotten/effaced'. እምላዕሌነ 'from upon us' (እም- + ላዕለ).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ ተመጠወ ፡ ዘባንነ ፡ ለኵናተ ፡ ፀርነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, was-handed-over back-our to-spears-of enemy-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! Our back was handed over to the spears of our enemy;
sentences.n: ተመጠወ 'was handed over' (passive of መጠወ). ዘባንነ 'our back/shoulders'. ኵናተ ፀርነ 'spears-of our enemy' (construct chain).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ ኮኑ ፡ ሕብልያ ፡ ደቂቅነ ፡ ወፄዋ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይእዜ ፡ ነሐበልዮሙ ፡ ወንፄውዎሙ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, became bonds(?) sons-our and-captives for-those-who now we-bind-them and-we-enslave-them;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! Our sons have become bound men (?) and captives to those whom we now (would) bind and enslave (?);
sentences.n: Crux, hedged (?). ሕብልያ I take as ሕብል 'rope, bond' (ሐበለ 'to bind'), so 'bound/in bonds'; ፄዋ 'captives' (ፄወወ 'take captive'). The last clause, with first-person plural imperfects ነሐበልዮሙ 'we bind them' and ንፄውዎሙ 'we enslave them', makes the sentence read oddly; I give a literal rendering and do not claim the sense is settled. ኮኑ 'they became' (3rd plural).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ በከያ ፡ አቤራቲነ ፡ ወላሐዋደናግሊነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, wept our-matrons(?) and-lamented our-virgins;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! Our matrons (?) wept and our virgins lamented;
sentences.n: በከያ 'they (fem. plural) wept'. አቤራቲነ is unfamiliar to me — a feminine plural, 'our ... women' — and I give 'matrons' as a guess (?). ወላሐዋደናግሊነ is printed fused: ወላሐዋ ደናግሊነ 'and our virgins lamented' (ላሐወ 'to lament' again, see the heading); ደናግል 'virgins'.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ አውየዉ ፡ ርሡኣኒነ ፡ ወከልሑ ፡ ሕፃናቲነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, cried-woe old-men-our and-shouted children-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! Our old men cried out and our children shouted;
sentences.n: አውየዉ 'they cried "woe"' (አውየወ, from ወይ 'woe'). ርሡኣኒነ 'our old men' (ርሡእ 'aged'). ከልሑ 'they shouted/cried out'. ሕፃናቲነ 'our little ones'.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ አንብዓ ፡ አንስቲያነ ፡ ወማሰነት ፡ ሀገርነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, tears-of women-our and-ruin-of land-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us! The tears of our women and the ruin of our land!
sentences.n: A nominal exclamation, no verb: አንብዓ አንስቲያነ 'tears-of our women' (አንብዕ 'tear', construct አንብዓ; ንስት plural አንስት + ያነ). ማሰነት 'ruin, perishing'. ሀገር 'land, city, country'.

sentences.t: አሌ ፡ ለነ ፡ አሌ ፡ ለነ ፡ እምዮም ፡ እስከ ፡ ተፍጻሜተ ፡ መዋዕሊነ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ደቂቅነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe to-us, woe to-us, from-today until end-of days-our, with sons-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us, from today until the end of our days, we and our children;
sentences.n: Here the refrain is spelled as separate words (አሌ ፡ ለነ), showing it is አሌ + ለነ. እስከ 'until'. ተፍጻሜተ መዋዕሊነ 'end-of our days' (construct chain). ምስለ ደቂቅነ 'with our children'.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ አሌለነ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተነሥተ ፡ ክብራ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ክብርት ፡ ወዐብየ ፡ ክብራ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ኅስርት ።
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, woe-to-us, for was-taken-away glory-her of-daughter-of Zion, honoured, and-grew glory-her of-daughter-of Ethiopia, lacking.
sentences.i: Woe to us, woe to us, for the glory of the daughter of Zion, the honored one, has been taken away, and the glory of the daughter of Ethiopia, the lacking one, has grown (?).
sentences.n: ወለተ ጽዮን 'daughter-of Zion' is a Hebrew-Bible phrase for the city/people. The glory is stated before its owner with a suffix (ክብራ ለወለተ 'her glory, of the daughter...'). ኢትዮጵያ Ethiopia, personified as another daughter. ኅስርት 'lacking' (feminine), ክብርት 'honored'. ዐብየ ('grew great') is my reading (?): Solomon, without knowing it, states the story's turn — the glory has passed to Ethiopia. This ends the lament proper.

sentences.t: ተምዕዐ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወመኑ ፡ ይሣሀል ፤
sentences.l: Was-angry God, and-who will-have-mercy?
sentences.i: God was angry, and who will show mercy?
sentences.n: A run of eight short statements in the same mould: a perfect verb with God as subject, then ወ- + a question or negation, 'who can...?'/'there is none who...'. They proclaim God's sovereignty. ይሣሀል 'he will have mercy'; መኑ 'who'. ተምዕዐ 'was angry'.

sentences.t: አስተራኰሰ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወመኑ ፡ ያነጽሕ ፤
sentences.l: Made-unclean(?) God, and-who will-cleanse?
sentences.i: God made unclean (?), and who will cleanse?
sentences.n: አስተራኰሰ I read as a causative of a root meaning 'be defiled' (?), set against ያነጽሕ 'he cleanses' (አንጽሐ); this contrast fits the next parallels. Not confirmed.

sentences.t: መከረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወመኑ ፡ ይትቃወማ ፡ ለምክሩ ፤
sentences.l: Planned God, and-who will-oppose his-plan?
sentences.i: God planned, and who will oppose his plan?
sentences.n: መከረ 'took counsel, planned'; ምክር 'counsel'. ይትቃወማ ለምክሩ 'will oppose (it), his plan' (ተቃወመ 'oppose'; the -ማ is a pronoun anticipating ለምክሩ).

sentences.t: ፈቀደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወመኑ ፡ የአብያ ፡ ለኅሊናሁ ፤
sentences.l: Willed God, and-who will-refuse his-purpose?
sentences.i: God willed, and who will refuse his purpose?
sentences.n: ፈቀደ 'wished'. የአብያ 'will refuse it' (አበየ 'refuse'; same root as አበይዋ in unit 39). ኅሊናሁ 'his thought, purpose'.

sentences.t: ይቤ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ይከውን ፤
sentences.l: Said God, and-all comes-to-be.
sentences.i: God spoke, and all comes to be.
sentences.n: Compare Genesis 1:3 ('God said, and it was'). ይከውን 'comes to be' (imperfect of ኮነ).

sentences.t: አኅሰረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያከብር ፤
sentences.l: Diminished God, and-there-is-none who-honours.
sentences.i: God brought low, and there is no one who honors.
sentences.n: አኅሰረ 'caused to lack' (causative of ኅሰረ, cf. ኅሱራን in 16). አልቦ ዘ- 'there is none who...' (አልቦ 'there is not').

sentences.t: ነሥአ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያገብእ ፤
sentences.l: Took God, and-there-is-none who-brings-back.
sentences.i: God took away, and there is no one who brings back.
sentences.n: ነሥአ 'took'; ያገብእ 'brings back' (አግብአ causative of ገብአ 'return').

sentences.t: ጸልአ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘያፈቅር ።
sentences.l: Hated God, and-there-is-none who-loves.
sentences.i: God hated, and there is no one who loves.
sentences.n: ጸልአ 'hated'; ያፈቅር 'loves'. With this unit the series of eight ends; it closes the paragraph of divine sovereignty and the lament turns back to Israel's guilt.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ክቡር ፡ ስምነዮምሰ ፡ ተመነነ ፡ ስምነ ፤
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, while honoured name-our, today-indeed was-despised name-our;
sentences.i: Woe to us! Though our name was honored, today our name is despised;
sentences.n: Source oddity: ስምነዮምሰ is two words fused, ስምነ ዮምሰ 'our name, today indeed'. እንዘ 'while/though' (introduces a circumstantial clause with a verbless predicate). ክቡር 'honored'. ተመነነ 'was despised' (መነነ 'to reject, despise'; passive).

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤት ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ አፍአ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ውስጥ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ተሰደድነ ፡ በኀጢአትነ ።
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, while men-of house we, we-became men-of outside; while men-of inside we, we-were-driven-out by-sin-our.
sentences.i: Woe to us! We were the household, and have become outsiders; we were insiders, and were driven out by our sin.
sentences.n: ሰብአ ቤት 'men-of house' (members of the household) against ሰብአ አፍአ 'men-of outside'. ኮነ 'we became' (1st plural, see 19). ተሰደድነ 'we were driven out' (ተሰደደ, passive). ንሕነ 'we' (independent pronoun).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ ንጽሐ ፡ ካህናትኒ ፡ አበይዋ ፡ ለንጽሕ ፡ ወአፍቀርዋ ፡ ለርኵስ ፤
sentences.l: For God loves purity; priests-too refused purity and-loved uncleanness;
sentences.i: For God loves purity; yet the priests refused purity and loved uncleanness;
sentences.n: ያፈቅር 'loves'. አበይዋ ለንጽሕ 'they refused it, purity' (the pronoun ዋ 'it' anticipates ለንጽሕ; አበየ 'refuse', not 'exalt'). አፍቀርዋ ለርኵስ 'they loved it, uncleanness'. The -ኒ on ካህናትኒ is 'also/yet'.

sentences.t: ወነቢያትኒ ፡ ገሠጹነ ፡ ወኢተገሠጽነ ፡ ወአስምዑነ ፡ ወኢሰማዕነ ፤
sentences.l: And-prophets-too rebuked-us and-not-we-were-corrected, and-warned-us and-not-we-heard;
sentences.i: And the prophets rebuked us and we were not corrected; they warned us and we did not listen;
sentences.n: ገሠጹነ 'they rebuked us' (ገሠጸ + ነ 'us'); ኢተገሠጽነ 'we were not rebuked/corrected'. አስምዑነ 'they bore witness to us, warned us' (አስምዐ). ኢሰማዕነ 'we did not hear/obey'.

sentences.t: አሌለነ ፡ በኀጢአትነ ፡ ተመነነ ፡ በኀሳርነ ፡ ተቀሠፍነ ።
sentences.l: Woe-to-us, by-sin-our we-were-despised, by-loss-our we-were-scourged.
sentences.i: Woe to us! Through our sin we were despised, and through our loss we were scourged.
sentences.n: ተመነነ here should be 1st plural 'we were despised' (= ተመንነነ, the double ነ written once, as in ተሰደድነ above). በኀጢአትነ 'in/by our sin' (በ- 'by, in'). በኀሳርነ 'in our loss/ruin'. ተቀሠፍነ 'we were scourged'. End of part 1; part 2 continues the lament.
